description: A JavaScript library for creating and rendering calendars, including day and month views, with interactive navigation features.

methods.name: createMonthTable
methods.description: Creates an HTML table representing a calendar month grid based on provided data and options.

methods.name: drawCalendarMonthTable
methods.description: Constructs the full calendar month view with header and body elements.

methods.name: drawCalendarDay
methods.description: Creates the day view of the calendar with header, date, and footer.

methods.name: extendSource
methods.description: Merges user options with default settings.

methods.name: getCalendar
methods.description: Returns detailed calendar information for a specific year, month, and date.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events for navigation buttons and month labels.

methods.name: dycalendar.draw
methods.description: Main function to render calendar in specified target element based on user options.

methods.name: drawCalendar
methods.description: Renders the calendar HTML inside the target element based on options.
